observations.behavior: Adds a PR-identity equality check before transitioning reports, and records the merged status on the run whose PR the report surfaced, not the webhook-bound run. This could prevent mismatched attestations and reduce stale inbox entries.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks that the report's surfaced PR identity matches the incoming PR identity before transitioning, and records the merged status on the run whose PR the report surfaced. This could reduce stale inbox entries and prevent mismatched attestations. No benefit or tier inferred.
